purpose: Current actual-model retrieval under simulated resource constraints, no quality tuning
corpus: Gate11 fixed 113 Rust source export, same exact bytes as Gates12/13
requests: Combined-session seed query, repeat, actual accepted-result feedback follow-up, then bounded evidence request-local override and repeat. Fresh resident JIT processes; source reads and RAM reuse counted separately.
contract: Exact response equality to unconstrained reference for every successful run; actual safetensors fingerprints, source bytes/mtime and no sidecars. Preserve failed limits with stage/exit/stderr; a resource failure is not a successful equivalence result. Disable core dumps.
measurements: OS per-process VmRSS/VmHWM/VmSize/Threads at ready and every request; startup/fill/resident/request diagnostics/stdout and diagnostic tokens. Three repetitions descriptive, not statistical latency proof.
limits: RLIMIT_AS is virtual address space, not physical RAM. CPU affinity plus fixed thread/worker count is a bundled scenario on the same Ryzen host/WSL. Not a real weak-device or Mac benchmark. No threshold/model/default changes from this stress test.
